verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
As the days go by, don't let my fire die
As the days grow old, don't let my love grow cold

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Oh Lord keep me burning
Oh Lord keep me burning
Oh Lord keep me burning

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Give me oil for my lamp keep me burning
Give me oil for my lamp I pray
Give me oil for my lamp keep me burning burning burning
Keep me burning till I see Your face
